production_invariant: PRODUCTION_READY requires every gate true, zero blockers, immutable evidence bound to the promoted SHA, and human approval for every public publication action.

blockers.reason: Authorize and configure managed platform credentials and account IDs.
Verify current platform public-posting review/audit requirements for every platform enabled in production.
Activate protected main and establish verified signed promotion flow.
Capture sandbox/live contract evidence after credentials and platform permissions are authorized.
Establish documentary rights/licence for the uploaded source footage and visible third-party material.
Establish permission or lawful basis for visible creator likeness, handle and identity elements.
Establish rights/licence for soundtrack, speech and any third-party audio.
Substantiate or remove claims implying free Bitcoin mining, crypto earnings or daily income before publication.
Complete platform-specific deceptive-practices/scams and monetization-policy clearance for the final edit and metadata.
Run the hardened workflow and capture a successful signed artifact attestation for the exact candidate SHA.
